about_the_game:
Polylumina is a musical simulation and visual sequencer: craft polyrhythmic chord progressions, watch each note pulse and bloom in vibrant patterns, and shape your own luminous symphony.

  • Create custom chord progressions effortlessly-any progression, any key!

  • Tweak visualizers in real time with intuitive controls.

  • Rotate, move and freely explore every pattern.
